name: Solenne Atelier Lumenweft Gala Glove
description:
Opera-length evening gloves from Solenne's Spire collection, woven from bioluminescent silk-analog thread that pulses with slow, breath-synchronized light shifts — aquamarine to amber to deep violet depending on the wearer's biometric state. The weave is open enough to reveal skin underneath in a lattice pattern, making chrome hands beneath them glow through the mesh like lit sculpture.

The upper arm portion terminates in a scalloped edge weighted with micro-glass beads sourced from a dissolved Osaka atelier. Each pair is hand-finished and registered to a single client biometric profile — unauthorized wear causes the bioluminescence to go flat gray.
functionality: Bioluminescent fiber pulses with wearer's biometric rhythm; biometric lock causes flat gray response on unauthorized wearers; open lattice permits chrome hand visibility as aesthetic feature; micro-glass weighted scalloped cuff provides drape structure.
what_it_says: You are dressed by someone who knows your heartbeat, and the dress proves it.
worn_by: augmented elites using chrome as fashion statement
story_hooks: A pair appears at auction registered to a client officially listed as deceased for six months — and the bioluminescence is still active.
Someone has cracked the biometric lock on a stolen pair using a harvested pulse-spoof chip, and they're wearing them into a Spire function they have no business attending.
The Osaka micro-glass beads contain an impurity traceable to a single contaminated melt — and three separate Spire families all have gloves from that batch.

physical_description.visual_profile: Elegant, elongated opera gloves extending from wrist to mid-upper-arm with a dramatic scalloped hem. The lattice weave creates an ethereal, semi-transparent effect that floats between concealment and revelation. When worn, they transform the hand into a glowing artifact—especially striking over chrome augmentation.
physical_description.fit: Precision-tailored to individual biometric profile; form-fitting through the hand and forearm with a gentle taper, then relaxes slightly at the upper arm. The scalloped edge sits gracefully mid-bicep without binding.
physical_description.primary_material: Bioluminescent silk-analog synthetic; lattice-woven to create negative space. Upper hem weighted with micro-glass beads harvested from dissolved Osaka atelier materials.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, almost liquid feel against skin; the weave creates a gossamer quality with subtle raised lattice ridges. Micro-glass beads add delicate weight and subtle texture variation at the scalloped edge.
physical_description.color_scheme: Base thread in clear/translucent silk-analog with embedded bioluminescent filaments. Light signature shifts from aquamarine → amber → deep violet, keyed to wearer's biometric state (heart rate, adrenaline, core temp). Scallop beads catch ambient light with iridescent shimmer.
physical_description.closures: None; precision biometric fit means they slip on and conform to individual hand geometry. Registration is subcutaneous via neural-linked authentication.
distinctive_features: Bioluminescent response tied to wearer's biometric state—real-time emotional/physiological display
Lattice weave deliberately frames chrome augmentation beneath, turning cyberlimbs into lit sculpture
Hand-finished scalloped edge with micro-glass beads from dissolved Osaka atelier (heritage reference)
Biometric lock-out: unauthorized wearers see flat gray, non-reactive state
Registered to single client profile—cannot be stolen or resold meaningfully
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1 luxury—haute couture evening wear. Price point and bespoke manufacturing place this in ultra-wealthy corpo aesthetic.
physical_description.cultural_context: Gala/high-society wear for those who can afford hand-registered luxury items. Signals wealth, access to bespoke tech integration, and comfort with visible augmentation. Wearer is confident enough to let their biometric state become visible—no shame in emotion or physical modification.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when first issued; ages gracefully with micro-wear on the beads and weave. The bioluminescent filaments remain reliable for years with proper biometric synchronization.
